tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 1)༄༅/ /theg pa thams cad kyi shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las smad cha zhes bya bzhugs so/ /
1)༄༅/ /theg pa thams cad kyi shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las smad cha zhes bya bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 1)༄༅/ /theg pa thams cad kyi shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las smad cha zhes bya bzhugs so//

༄༅/ /theg pa thams cad kyi shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las smad cha bzhugs/ ka: thog pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug spa gro stag tshang du mdzad pa zhu dag byed pa po slob dpon gnag mdog dpal ldan 'brug gzhung thim phu 1997 2) /gnyis pa dka' thub ragi byid kyis theg pa la yang gnyis te/ mtshan nyid dang*/ gsang sngags kyis khyad par dang*/ bye brag so so nas bshad pa'o// dang po ni la la dag bzhi 'bras nas khyad par med de/ thabs lam gyis khyad par yod zer ba de mi 'thad de/ shes bya bshis yin tshul nas 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad la khyad par med na/ lam la khyad par yod pa 'gal la/ de rtogs shing 3) /mngon du gyur ba'i cha nas/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ka la khyad par yod de/ mtshan nyid dang*/ gsang sngags khyis sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ don dam gyis khyad par ro// dang po ni/ don dam pa na rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis su med pa la kun rdzob rgyu lam du byed cing*/ mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa gtso bo ru ston pa ni rgyu mtshan nyid do// 'bras bu lam du byed cing dbyer med gtsor ston pa ni 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa'o// po pi te ka ra las/ 4) don gcig la yang ma rmongs shing*// thabs mang dka' ba medo pa dang*/ dbang po rno po dbang byas nas// sngags kyis theg pa khyad par 'phags// ceso// gnyis pa don dam gyis khyad par ni/ shes bya'i gzhi la gting phyin par rtogs ma rtogs kyis khyad par dang*/ 'bras bu lam du byed mi byed kyis khyad par dang*/ 'bras bu 'dus byas ma byas kyis khyad par ro// de rnams kyis khyad par rang rang gis skabs nas bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag so so'i bshad pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go dang po ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gtso bor ston cing lus dag yid gsum dka' spyad la gnas pa'i phyi rgyud kyisatheg pa de yang*/

rang gis ngos la dbye ba med kyang*/ yul gdul bya'i rnam pa gsum du snang ba yin te/ de nas lus kyi bya ba gtsor ston pa bya pa'i rgyud/ lus dag gis bya ba ting nge 'dzin mnyam du spyod pa'i rgyud/ nang gis ting nge 'dzin 5) /gtsor ston pa rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud/ de yang brjod bya'i rgyud gzhi lam 'brel chags shing rjod byed phun sum tshogs pa lnga 'dzoms pa rgyud kyis dngos po rnams ma tshang ba med pa'o// de yang 'dul pa'i gdul bya blo'i bye brag ni/ dbang po 'bring la yang gsum ste/ 'bring gis tha ma dang*/ 'bring gis 'bring*/ 'bring gi mchog 'dul ba'i thabs la yang gsum du snang ba'o// spyi changis las/ dka' thub ragi byed theg pa yang*/ yul gyis rnam pa gsum nyid do/ bya ba spyod pa rnal 'byor rgyud// gdul bya blo'i bye brag ni// 'bring po nyid la' marnam gsum te// tha ma 'bring dang mchog du snang*// 'dul thabs de bzhin gshegs pas bye brag gsum// ces so// gnyis pa bye brag bya ba'i rgyud la bdun te/ 'jug sgo dang*/ lha ba/ ting nge 'dzin/ spyod pa dam tshig gi lam gyis yun/ 'bras bu'o// spyi chings 6) las/ 'jug sgo lta ba'i ting 'dzin dang*// spyod dang tshul khrims lam gyis yun// 'bras bu dag dang bdun du bshad// ces so// dang po la gnyis te/ gsang sngags spyi'i 'jug sgo dang*/ khyad par bya ba'i 'jud sgo'o// dang po la ni/ kun rdzob lha'i dkyil 'khor dang don dam sems nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum 'gro 'ong gis mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin bden gnyis dbyer med ku+is sgor 'jug de nyid las/ gsang sngags spyi'i 'jug sgo ni/ bden gnyis dbyer med sgo nas 'jug ces so// gnyis pa khyad par bya rgyud rang gis 'jug sgo ni/ lus dag pa mi dge ba gsum spa das/ dag dag pa mi dge ba bzhi spadas/ yid dag pa mi dge ba gsum spangs pas rnam par dag pa'o// yang lus lha'i sku/

dag gsung*/ yid thugs kyis rang bzhin du 'jug pa yin te/ de nyid las/ khyad par bya ba'i 'jug sgo ni// lus dag yid gsum rnam dag pas// sku gsum thugs 7) /kyi rang bzhin 'jug /ces dang*/ rdzogs chen nges don 'dus pa las/ dag pa gsum gyi sgor zhugs nas// yo byad phyi la gtsor 'dzin cing// ces gsungs so// spyi don gnyis pa lta ba la gnyis te/ bya ba'i lta ba dang*/ gsad sngags spyi'i lta ba'o// dang po ni/ snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis ma grub pas yod med la sogs kyis mtha' dang bral zhing/ de nyid ma rtogs pa'i snang ngor sgyu ma rmi lam gyis tshul du 'khrul snang ma 'gags pa'irnam par snang dus/ don gyis rang bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa 'bras bu rigs gsum gyis dkyil 'khor ye nas chu dang glan bzhinas so// de nyid las/ lha ba snod bcud chos 'di rnams// don dam spros bral mtha' dang bral ba las kun rdzob sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid 'di// 'khrul pa'i ngo la cir snang yang// de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'bras bu ngo bo ye nas gnas// 8) chu dang sher ba ci bzhin no// ces gsungs so// don dam sems nyid dag pa mtha' bzhid dag pa mtha' bzhi dang bral ba 'dod cing*/ de ldogs pa'i yon tan kun rdzob rigs gsum ltar snang ba'o// la shan las/ dmigs pa phra mo bya ba nyid// rang sems mtha' bzhi yongs bral ba'o// rig phyir ye shes gzhan min// ces dang*/ gleng glang snang ba'i ye shes kyi// mthong ba'i dngos po mtho' mjal rtsub// drug phyed rigs kyis dkyil 'khor du// mthong bas rnam par dag par lta// ces gsungs so/ gnyis pa spyi'i lta ba ni/ mtshan nyid las 'phags pa'i gsang sngags kyi lta ba ni/ rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i rnam kun mtshog ltan del gzhan pa'i kun rdzob med par 'dod de/ spyi chings las/ bden gnyis ye nas dbyer med pas// gsang sngags spyi'i lta ba yin// ces dang/

lam rim las/ rnam par byang dang sdug bsdal dag// kun rdzob du yang dbyer med de// lta ba mtho' dman de tsam mo// ces dang*/ 9) /denya las/ 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas snang*// 'dus byas snangab rdo rje nyid/ yin phyir ngo bo tha dad med// ces pa la sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa bhai pa la gnyis te/ gcig char dang*/ rim pa'i/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa phra mo byab nyid// rang sems mtha' bzhi yongs bral ba'o// ces lta ba gcig char du 'dod pa/ bhai pa gcig char du grol par gsungs te/ mi g.yo' rtogs pa rdo rje chen po'i rgyud las snang srid chos skur sems kyis gsal// 'byung zhing sems kyis 'du 'phrobs// yul rtogs cir snang cigyur yang*/ dgags cing spang duci yang med// ces dang*/ rtogs parags pa'i ngo bo 'di nyid// rim gyis sbyangs pas mi sbyang ste/ sems kyis rang bzhin shes pa las// skad cig gis ston chos kyi sku// sems ni ma bcos 'od gsal ba// cir snang ci sṛd ci 'byung yang*// rang 'byung rangasnang ngang gis mthong*// ces so/ gnyis ba 10) rim skyes pa la gnyis te/ mtshan bcos/ dang po ni/ rtogs pa'i ngang las bying rgod kyis dbang du ma shor bar nyams su blangs bsarim gyis rtogs ba'i ye shes 'phel te sangs rgyas gsungs te/ de nyid las/ de ltar shes na ci la yang*// mi bsam ma yengs par bzhag ste// bying rgod dbang du ma btang na// rang dbad med par don rig cing*// nang nas ye shes 'od shar pa'i// sems la rig pa'i nyims myong 'char// yun ring ba ri gnas pa'i mthus// mi g.yo'i ye shes shugs kyis skye// ye nas sangs rgyas ngo bo 'di// the tshom mid par mthong bar 'gyur// ces gsudas so༈ ༈ gnyis pa lha bhai pa ni/ bdag dam tshig gis sems 'abhai pa dang*/ lha ye shes sems dpa' bhai pa dang*/ cho ga'i yan lag bcu gcig bhai zhing bsgrub bar byed pa'o// dang po ni rang gi/

lus dag yid gsum lha'i sku gsungathugs su bhai pa ste/ de yang skyed tshul ni/ bsod nams kyis mchog nas 11) /swa bha was stong par sbyangs pas chos nyid kyis lhā+o// stong pa'i sgra grags ba sgra snyan gyis lha/ yig 'bru dngos su byung ba gsung yig 'bru'i lha/ gdan zla ba las byung gdan gyi lha/ de'i stong du sa pon phyag mtshan byung ba phrag mtshan gyis lha/ de la rigs gsum gang mos kyis lhag gis skur bskyed pa sku'i phyag rgya'i lha'o// de yang spyi ching salas/ bya ba'i rnal 'byor bsam gtan ni// lus dag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// drug gis 'jug ba'i tshul nyid kyis// lha'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba las// ces pa dang*/ gnyis pa ye shes sems do' ni/ mdun gyis nam mkha' la ye shes pa spyan drangs tshul ni bkur 'os jo bo'i tshul drangs na/ phyag 'tshal la sogs yan lag bdun gyis tshogs bsags cing rang gis smin mtshams kyis thad kyis nam mkhar bzhugs pa bhai mo// gsum pa bhai zlas ni/ spyi chings las/ bzlas brjod bsnyen pa 12) rgyun mi bcad// dngos grub blangs te gtang rags gsol// ces pas/ bdag gis thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng gis 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa'i mthar thim par bsam/ de ltar bhai zlas byas pas/ sngags brgya stong la sogs zlas dus/ glal ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bya'o/ rjes su gtang rags gtong zhing dngos grub blangs nas gsol ba gdab/ rjes la gshegs gsol/ bkris/ dge rtsa bsngo'o// mi dmigs pas rgyas gtab rnams ni spyi mthun no// de nyid las/ ye shes sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ bkur 'os jo bo'i tshul nyid du// mdun gyis nam mkha' la spyan 'dren te// phyag 'tshal sogs yan lag bdun// bsod nams tshul du tshogs bsags shing*// bzlas brjod bsnyen pa rgyun mi bcad// dngos grub blangs te gtang rags gsol// ces so// bzhi pa spyod pa ni/

khrus dang gtsang sbra dang*/ dkar gsum/ 13) /mngar gsum/ ras kha tshar dang*/ phud ma nyams pa la spyod/ sha chang sgog gsum la sogs pa'i rku ba'i zas spang*/ lha'i dri ma mi 'goms shing nye dang thor 'thung bya ba laso gas pa'i/ g.yu' thang las/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la 'bad/ ces sogs dang*/ sbyi chings las༈ bya ba'i rgyud kyis pa ni// dag pa gsum gyis mtha' bzung nas// khrus dang gtsang sbra bder spyod do/ zhag grangs dus tshod gza' rgyun skar// gtsang ma'i yo byad la sogs pa// rten 'brel 'dzoms na 'grub par bshad// ces gsungs so// lnga pa dam tshig ni/ sbyi chings las/ bya ba bsrung ba'i dam tshig ni/ so so thar dang byang chub sems// spyi'i sdom brtson mi gshig cing*// lus dag yid gsum dam tshig dag// 'da' bar mi byed yan lag bcas// bye brag tshul du gnas pa yin// ces dang*/ bya rgyud kyis dam tshig ni/ so so thar pa rigs bdun dang*/ byang chub sems dba' ba smon 14) 'jug gnyis dang*/ theg pa 'og ma'i sdom dang*/ tshul khrims yar ldan du bsrung zhing*/ khyad par bya ba rang gis thun mong ma yin pa lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs las mi dha ba'i rtsa ba yanalag gis dam tshig bsrung tshul lo// drug pa lam yun ni/ zag bcas kyi yun dang*/ zag med do/ dang po ni/ ring ltar thogs na mi tshe bcu drug gam/ yun thung na mi tshe bdun gyis bar du/ rgyal rigs dang bram ze gtsang ma la sogs 'dod khams gzugs khams kyis lus rten gtsang ma'i rigs su 'gyur nas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyis 'jug nas rig 'dzin gyis sal sbyor ba'o// de yang spyi chings las/ bya ba'i rnal 'byor 'grub pa'i yun// ring ltar mi tshe bcu drug gi /rgyal rigs bram ze gtsang ma dang*// 'dod pa'i lha dang gzugs kyis khams// gtsang ma'i lus 'dzin gsang sngags kyis// theg pa chen por bsgrub par 'gyur// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

de ltar zag bcas 15) kyis lam la mi tshe mthar phyin nas/ zag pa dang bral nas rang gi lha'i sku nyid brtan pa thob cing*/ mngon du gyur te/ lus yi dam lha'i sku snang nas 'og min dga' ldan la sogs par rnam par bsags pa'i zhing khams su snang bar 'gyur ro// de nas mi'i skye ba bcu drug tshun chad kyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa non te/ sku lnga thob te/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku/ do bo nyid kyis sku/ bdeb chen po'i sku/ rdo rje'i sku dang dbyer med lhun gyis grub ba'o// mdo' las/ rigs kyis rdo rje 'dzin gnas pa'o// ces dang*/ bcu drug mtha' zag bral nas// rang gis lha'i sku nyid kyis༈ ༈phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 'gyur// rnam dag zhing du rab snang ste// brgya' phrag bcu drug tshun chad kyis// rdo rje 'dzin ba'i sa non te// sku lnga lhun gyis grub par 'gyur// ces gsungs so// theg pa'i shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las/ bya ba rgyud kyis rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste/ 16) bcu pa'o// ༈ //gnyis pa spyod rgyud kyi theg pa la gnyis las/ spyi dang*/ bye brag go snga ma ni/ lus dag yid kyis spyod pa gtsor ston pa'i theg pa ni/ dbang po 'bring gis 'bring du gyur pa'i// spyi chings las/ spyod pa'i rnal 'byor byeg bdun/ dbang po 'bring gis 'breng gyur pa༈ ༈ces so// gnyis pa bye brag du bshad pa la/ 'jug sgol sogs bdun las/ 'jug sgo spyod dmatshig gsum bya ba'i rnal 'byor dang mthun la/ lta ba rnal 'byor yog mthun pa'o// de yang spyi chings las/ 'jug sgo sbyod pa dam tshig gsum// bya ba'i rnal 'byor dag dang mtshungs// lta ba rnal 'byor rjes su 'gro// ces so// bhai pa ni/ de nyid gzhi'i tshul du bhai pa ste/ bdag gis de kho na nyid dam tshig gis sems dpa'askyed/ lha'i de kho na nyid ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa nas/ smin mtshams kyis thad sor bzhag pas/

ting de 'dzin gyis de kho na nyid bdag dang thugs kanas zla 17) /ba dang yig 'bru sngags 'khor skor bas/ sngags kyis de khon nyid sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' thams cad bskul/ tshur 'dus dngos grub brtsol bar bsam/ lung de nyid las/ bsam gtan rnam snang ting 'dzin las// de nyid gzhi'i tshul dag gis// bsnyen sgrub yan lag rdzogs par 'gyur// ces so// drug pa lam yun ni/ zag bcas dang*/ zag med gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ring na mi tshe bdun/ nye na mi tshe lnga nas/ zag med la sbyor bar byeng de/ de'i skye ba'i khyad par ni bya rgyud dang mthun no// gnyis pa zag med ni/ zag bcas de nyid mthar phyin nas las dang nyon mongs khams kyis zag pa gsum zad cing*/ sku phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de nas mi tshe bcu drug tshun la/ rigs gsum dbyer med pa'i rang gzhi rnam par snang mdzad kyis skus rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du gyur 18) ba'o// de nyid las/ zag bcas sa la mi tshe bdun// skye ba gong dang 'dra ba las// de mthar zag gsum zad gyur nas// phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 'gyur| |bsam gtan lam la rnam gnas te// brgya phrag bcu drug tshun chod kyis// rigs gzhi rdo rje 'chang gis sa// 'bras bu thob pa gdon mi za'// ces gsungs so// theg pa'i shan 'bred nyi 'od rab gsal las/ sbyod rgyud kyis rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste/ bcu gcig pa'o/// / ༈ gsum pa rnal 'byor yo ga'i theg pa la bdun las/ dang po 'jug sgo ni/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyis sgor 'jug pa yin te/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ dka' thub dka' dbyad 'dir mi dgos// khyus dang gtsang 'dir mi dgos// sangs rgyas thams cad sangs rgyas cher// bdag tu 'gyur pa'i 'grub gyur las| |ces dang*/ spyi chings las/ rnal 'byor rnam gnyis 'jug pa'i sgo// ces so// gnyis pa lta ba ni/ don dam dbyings ye shes dbyer 19) /med pa'i mtha' bral chen po chos kyi skur ston pa dang*/ de nyid rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kun rdzob rigs lnga rdo rje dbyings kyis lhar snang ba'o// la shan las/ rnal 'byor gnyis dbang smra gzhung ni// thams cad sems kyis rlab snang phyir// de nyid mtha' stong rigs gsal bas// rgyu rkyen ma byas mtha' bral ba'i// rang bzhin chos kyi sku nyid do// kun gzhi sems 'dun tshun bzhag du// chos kun snang ba'i byin rlabs dril// rdo sogs rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du// sangs ma rgyas pa med pa ni// rang bzhin stug po bkod pa'o// ces dang*/ spyi chings las/ pha rol nang dang gnas 'di kun// yul dngos ma skye chos kyi dbyidas// 'dzin pa bdag med ye shes dang*// de nyid ye nas dbyer med pas// rnal 'byor zhes bya'i lta ba yin// ces so// gsum pa bhai pa ni/ rtogs pa'i don la mngon par byad chub pa ldas nyams su le na te/ de yang sems 'gags 20) pa med pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i rigs pa byang chub pas/ del yig 'bru' a las zla ba tshes pa je cher la gnas sam gang bar bsam pa ni sems bskyed pa la byang chub pa/ de las sems kyis ngo bo hūm̐ du bsam pa ni chos nyid rgyud gnas pa la byang chub pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa la rdo rje rtse lnga pa gyin du 'greng bar gyur pa ni/ rten pa la mngon par byang chub pa/ phyag mtshan gyis 'du 'phro las rnam par snang mdzad kyis skur pa bhai pa ni/ sku mthar phyin las mngon par byang chub pa'o// de nyid kyis dang la rang nyid lha'i sku skyed pa ste/

de las cho' phrul bzhi'i rgyud sbyangs pa ni/ 'khor bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul lo// dbang bskur ba'i/ mchod pa'i/ phyag rgya bzhi'i cho 'phrul gyis sgo nas sems can gyis rgyud sbyangs pa'o// dam tshig pa skyed pa de la ye shes sems dpa' yul nas gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis brten par bzhugs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i 21) /dngos po dkar gsum la sogs pa mchod/ de yang spyi chings las/ mngon par byang chub rnam lnga yi// rang gis lha yi sku bskyed de// tshul khrims bzhi'i rgyud sbyangs nas// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'o// ces so// de ltar dam tshig pa dang ye shes sems grogs pa'i tshul du cho ga'i yan lag rdzaugs par nyams su len no// gong gis lung de nyid las/ rkyen lam rnal 'byor rnam gnyis kyis// mngon byas lhun grub rnal 'byor ni// byin rlabs ya mtshan bsam yas kyang*// rnal 'byor gsal la mnyam par 'dod// ces dang*/ g.yu' thang las/ rang rig dngos stong mtshan ma gnyis// dbyer med 'breng dang ye shes las// byin rlabs rdo rje dbyings sprul lha// shar lta grogs po'i tshul du mchod// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa spyod pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gtso che bar gsungs te/ de nyid las/ spyod pa 'jig rten gtsor byed pa'o// ces gsungs 22) pas/ sems kyis spyong pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i dang nas dag gis spyod pa ni bzlas pa sngags dang dbyangs la sogs pa'o// gar dang phyag rgya la sogs pa ni lus kyi spyod pa'o// de dag 'dzoms nas bsgrub pa la 'og ma ltar rdzas dang yo byad dang gtsor ma gsungs kyang*/ 'byor pa mchod na mchog du gyur bar bshad do// ces so// lnga pa dam tshig ni/ thun mong du 'og ma'i so thar dang smon 'jug dang byas spyod kyis dam tshig yar ldan du gsungs pa ni bde gshegs rigs kyis dam tshig rdo rje slob dpon rtag du bkur zhing*/

rdo rje dril bu thabs kyi brten du 'chang ba ni rdo rje rigs kyis dam tshig chos dang zang dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs kyis sbyin pa ni rani chen/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems gsang sngags phyi nang gsang gsum gyis theg pa'i chos la nyan bsam la brtson pa ni pad ma/ 'phags pa'i tshogs la bsod nams kyis tshogs bsags pa ni las kyi rigs kyis dam tsh-ig 23) /go /spyi chings las/ bsrungs ba'i tshul khrims bye brag ni// 'og ma rnams dang ldan bzhin du// rigs lnga'i dam tshig mchog du sngags// bsdom gsum mi spangs bder gshegs rigs// bla ma rdo rje dril bur ldan// rtag tu bkur 'chang rdo rje'i rigs// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin gsum ldan pa rin chen rigs// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// nyan bsam pad ma rigs kyis dam// 'phags tshogs rtag tu mchod pa ni// las kyi rigs kyis dam tshig go /ces so// drug pa lam gyis yun la gnyis te/ zag bcas dang/ zag med do// dang po ni/ rnal 'byor yo ga'i 'grod pa'i yun ring na mi tshe lnga/ thung na mi tshe gsum gyis nang du sku phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 'grub cing*/ de nas 'khor ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa zad cing dag nas/ khams gsum du 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa dang 'bral ba'o// spyi chings las/ mi tshe 24 ) gsum gyi nang rol du// phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin 'grub// las dang nyon mongs kun byang nas// khams gsum 'jigs dang zag pa bral/ ces so// gnyis pa zag med ni/ de nas zag med mthong lam nas/ mi tshe bcu drug tshun la phra rags kyi sgrib pa rnams bhai phyag rgya chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs nas/ mthar lam lhun grub rig 'dzin gyis bar du nyams su blang pas stug po bkod pa'i sa la sbyor bar byed do// de nyid las/ de tshe bcu drug tshun chod kyis// phra rab shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs nas// ces so// bdun pa 'bras bu ni/

gong ltar zag bcas zag med mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu stug po bkod pa'i sa non te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'o// dgongs 'dus las/ gtsang ma'i rigs dag spang pa yi// 'og min zhes bya'i nyams dga' de// yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas// sprul pa po gcig 'dir sangs rgyas// ces gsungs pas/ 25) /stug po bkod pa de la yon tan ci lta bu zhes na/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud las/ chos sku dpag med brjod du med/ longs spyod zad med rin cen gter// sprul pa bye ba bsam mi khyab/ de dag gis don mdzad tshul ni// de tshe 'gro drug thams cad la// sdig spong gzugs su rnam par ston// dge tshul rnams la dgra bcom gzugs// rang rgyal rnams la bse' ru'i tshul// gzhan yang theg mchog rim pa bzhin// 'og min bla med gnas mchog tu// sku ni rnam par snang mdzad tshul// byang chub sems kyis 'khor rnams la/ de bzhin gsung mchog mi smra ste// sku'i chos rnams mjal bar ston// me long stan pa'i tshul bzhin du// dang po'i mdog ngan thams cad sel// 'khor gyis de bzhin kun ltas nas// byang chub sems dpa'i sgrib dpag med// me long bzhin du sku la snang*// de nas sa bcu rim 26) gyis byang*// bla med byang chub yang dag thob// ces gsungs so// theg pa thams cad kyis shan 'byed nyi 'od rab gsal las/ rnal 'byor gyud kyis rnam par dag pa'i le'u ste/ bcu gnyis pa'o/// / ༈ gsum pa dbang bsgyur thabs kyis theg pa la bzhi ste/ gsang sngags kyis ngo bo ngais tshig stan pa dang*/ 'og ma rnams dang shan dbye' ba dang*/ lam mi mthun pa'i phyogs gol sgrib bsal ba dang*/ rtogs nas nyams su len pa'i rim pa'o// dang po ni ngo bo dang*/ ngais tshig gnyis las/ dang po gsang sngags kyis ngo bo ni/ sangs rgyas dang sems can kun gyis don gyi snying po gsang ba dam pa yin zhing rgyal bkun gyis dam par bsngags pas na gsang sngagaso// gnyis pa/

ngais tshig ni/ blo thun mong rnams kyis spyod yul du ma gyur pas gsang ba/ yon tan thams cad 'byung bas bsngags so// 27) /dang po ni/ mdo' las/ e ma ho/ ngo mtshar rmad kyis chos// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang*// gsang sngags gsang ba'i snying po ni// sangs rgyas sems can kun gyis gsang*// ces gsungs pas/ gsang ba zhes bya ni smrar med pa spyod yul du ma gyur ba la bya'o// phyi ma ni/ mdo' las/ 'di ni gsang ba'i snying po ste// rdo rje sems dpa' de kho na nyid// nges pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir// rgyal bkun gyis dam par bsngags// ces pas/ sngags ces bya ba ni/ yon tan gyis 'byung gnas su gyur pa la bya'o// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa 'og ma rnams dang shan 'byed pa ni/ mdo' sde pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ yo ga man chad nas kyang theg pa thod rgal ba gong ltar 'char bar gsungs pa las/ gcig char ba ni/ theg pa re re'i sgor zhugs kyang gang gis phyogs 'dzin med par 28) mnyam pa ris med du rtogs shing*/ grol bar gsungs nas 'dug pas/ de tsho la khyad par 'dug pa ni/ ma dpogs so// gsungs/ theg pa rang rang gis lugs la ba rten nas gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum kal khyad par nyid rgyu lam du byas su 'gyur la/ gsang sngags ni chos kun rang byung ye shes su yin la/ de nyid ci lta ba bzhin du byas pas 'dus ma byas pa'o// phya ma ni/ mtshan nyid pas shugs kyis spang bya lhag ma dang bcas pa thob bya lhag ma dang bcas pa gong ma'i shugs kyis shes par bya'o// gsang sngags sku gsum grangs mthun yang ngo bo khyad par yod pas/ de yang gnas lugs kun rdzob du yang bden pa dbyer med dus gsum 'du bral med par rtogs pas 'bras bu rdo rje'i sku mngon du gyur pa'o// chos kun shes bya lhag ma med par 'dus ma byas kyis ye shes lhun grub bdag nyid chen bor rtogs pas/ ngo bo nyid chos kyi sku thob pa'o// rgyas par rang rang

29) /gis skabs bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyis pa gsang sngags phyi nang gi khyad par ni/ phyi nang gis rgyu mtshan dang*/ khyad par ro// don dam dbyings ye shes dbyer med tsam du rtogs kyang thams cad bdag nyid chen por ma rtogs pas/ lha dang ye shes sems dpa' la dngos grub re zhing*/ spyod pa blang dor byed pa ni phyi ma/ chos kun bdag nyid chen por rtogs pas lha dang dngos kyang rig pa'i cho 'phrul las ma g.yos shing*/ s+sapayod pa blang dong med par dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa la longs spyod ba ni nang pa'o// gnyis pa khyad par la gsum ste/ gzhi dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ shes bya yin tsul la khyad par med la/ de nyid theg pa'i 'dod lugs la khyad par yod de/ sngags phyi pa don dam dbyings ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rnam par snang mdzad la sogs par 'dod la/ kun rdzob ni de'i byin rlabs dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis 30) su 'dod pa'o// nang pa'i mahā yo ga yang bden pa gnyis dbyer med spyod yul dang bral ba'o// kun rdzob du yang 'khor 'das gnyis su med para'adod pa'o// lam rim las/ thabs kyi theg pa chen po ni// rnam par byang dang sdug bsngal dag /kun rdzob du yang dbyer med de// lta ba ma tho' dam na de tsam mo// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa lam ni/ lta ba/ bhai pa/ spyod pa'i khyad par ro// dang po/ gshis 'dod tsul gyis khyad par bzhin te/ de rtogs pa'i lta ba la yang khyad par yod de/ rang rang gis skabs nas bshad pa bzhin no// bhai pa ni/ gsang sngags pa mtshan nyid don dam gyis phyogs su lhung la/ mtshan bcas kun rdzob phyogs su lhung ste/ de yang dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa tha dad par 'dod cing dngos grub gzhan nas re ba dang bcas pa'o// nang pa'i bden pa dbyer med bdag nyid chen por rtogs pas/ lha la sogs pa thams cad sems kyi 31) /cho 'phrul rang snang yin te/ dngos grub gzhan nas re ba'i rtsol ba med pa'o// spyod pa ni/

phri pa dag ma dag gnyis su phye nas blang dor rtsol ba dang bcas pa'o// nang pa ni chos sku bdag nyid chen por rtogs pas spyod pa blang dor med pa'o// 'bras bu ni/ grangs rdzogs ma rdzogs kyis khyad par dang*/ ngo bo 'dus byas ma byas kyis khyad par dang*/ dgongs pa'i tshul gyis khyad par ro// dang po ni/ yo ga rigs lnga thob kyang sku gsum las med pa'o// nang pa ni sku lnga lhun grub mngon du gyur bas thob bya lhag ma med pa'o// gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ phyi pa dngo grub gzhan la re zhing*/ rtsol bas bsgrub pas 'dus byas yin la/ nang pa ni/ bdag nyid chen por ye nas sangs rgyas pa nyid mngon du gyur pas 'dusam byas pa'o// gsum pa dgongs pa'i tshul ni/ phyi bas ngo bo gcig kyangs pa'i ye shes ma 'dres par 'dod la/ nang pa ni/ thun 32) mong ma yin pa'i dbyer med chen por ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs so// spyi don gsum pa lam gyis gol sgrib bstan pa dang*/ gong ma dang bye brag phyes te bstan pa'o/ snga ma ni/ rdzogs pa chen kun gsal las/ gong ma'i don ma mthong bas sgrib pa yin te/ gong mas 'og ma'i las spyad gol ba yin te/ ces dang*/ kun byed las/ chos kun snying po byang chub sems gcig la// gcig la rnam par bgrang ba'i gol sgrib byung*// 'grod du med pa bsgrod pa'i gol sa byung*// dmigs pa med pa ltas pas ma mthong sgrib pa byung*// ces pas/ lam yin min 'dra la min pas na golas/ gong ma'i don mthong dus med pas sgrib pa'o// gnyis pa bye brag ni/ gol sa dang*/ sgrib pa'o// snga ma ni/ lta ba'i gol sa/ bhai pa'i/ spyod pa'i/ 'bras bu'i gol sa'o// spyir gol sar ltung ba'i sgod gul sogs pa'o// mu stegs 33) /kyis lta bar gol ba dang*/ zhor 'byung gis mu stegs su gol ba dang*/ theg pa 'og ma 'og ma gong ma gong ma'i gol sa dang lam stegs su bstan pa'o// mu stegs dang zhon 'byung sngar nas bshad pa bzhin no// khyad par du gsang sngags kyi

'bras bu lam du byed pa dang*/ sems yin pa dang*/ bdag nyid chen por yin pa la sogs pa'i gzhung las/ phyogs re tsam 'dra ba la don log par go ste/ mu stegs grangs can pa dang*/ dbang phyug pa dang*/ rigs byed kyis mtha' gsar par smra ba'i bsde ba la sogs pa'i 'dod pa dang*/ mthun par gol ba rnams kyis dmigs shes par byas la gol bar spyad pa'o// hril dril na grub mtha' las log cing gol bani/ chos thams cad dgos byed dgong gzhi mtha' bzhi rang grol du gsungs pa la/ zhe 'dod kyis phyogs rer bzung nas gol ba la bzhi ste/ stong nyid thal 34) drag chad par gol ba dang*/ chos nyid thal drag dngos paro dang*/ bden gnyis thal drag gzung 'dzin dang*/ dbyer med thal drag dmugs rtug mtha' la thug pa'o// dang po ni/ dgos byed dang*/ dgongs gzhi/ chos thams cad stong nyid dang*/ rang bzhin med pa la sogs ba gsungs pa yin te/ dgos byed ni/ 'grodrug a mthas zhen par kha ma'i 'dzin pa grol ba dang*/ dgongs gzhi sems nyid rang snang la dngos po dang mtshan ma'i sel med ba la dgongs nas ngasungs pa'o/ de ltar ma shes te yang dag pa'i phugs stong pa cang med du 'dod pa ni/ mu stegs chad pa'i mthar gol ba yin te/ nam mkha' klong yangs las/ stong par rtag pa don la 'khrul// mu stegs chad par lta ba dang*// tshig la khyad yod don la med// ces dang*/ mdo' las/ stong pa nyid du mu chad pa// chad pa'i lam chen nyid du 'gyur// denas slar yang 35) /'phos pa yis// grol thar lam 'di chad par 'gyur// ces dang*/ gsang thig las/ thams cad 'dod nas dag pa'i blo yul min// de ni chad pa'i mtha' ste grol ba med// ces pa lo sogs bka' rgyud du ma nas de nyid gol zhing dmyal bar 'gro bar gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ chos kun yenas sangs rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ snang ba 'di tshes nyid yin pa lo sogs pa gsungs te/ dgos byed ni| sangs rgyas gzhan nas tshol ba'i gol ba 'gag cing*/

snang sems gnyis med chos sku chen por ngo sprad pa dang*/ dgongs gzhi chos kun rang byung gis ye shes su ye nas sangs rgyas shing snang chos nyid rang snang ba la dgongs nas gsungs so// de la 'khrul grol gyis shan ma phyed par gnyis 'dzin rang kha ma'adi kho na ltar sangs rgyas yin ces pa ni/ tshig tsam la dam par lta ba mchog tu bzung nas/ theg pa gzhan dang nyams su 36) myong ba rnams la lta ba dman zhes bskur ba 'debs pa'o// gsang thig las/ chos dang sems nyid so sor mi 'gyur bas// de ni rtag pa'i mtha' de grol ba med// ces dang*/ nam mkha' klong yangs las/ rang sems rgyun gyis rtag par 'dod// bdag dang khas len mu stegs dang*/ tsh-ig la khyad yod don la med// ces so// ye shes gsang ba las/ lta spyod log pa'i nga rgyal can// ma bcos rang snang rol pa dang*// rnam rtog zhen pas rtogs pa dag /bye brag ma phyed rmongs pa'i blo// rdo la gser du 'dzin pa bzhin// 'od gsal lhun grub rang snang dang*// rtag pa'i zhen pa bsres nas smra// ma bcos rig pa'i gding med par// lta ba yang rab mtho' 'dod pa// bab chol 'dod 'dra spyad pas log// de'i dus kyi gang zag rnams// sbrel la g.yang su lhung bzhin// rdo rje khams gsum ltung bar gyur nas// byang chub sems dpa'i rigs dang bral// 37) /ces gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ dgos byed dang dgongs gzhi bden ba gnyis su phre ba yin te/ dgos byed ni/ bdag dang bdag gis 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol zhing*/ bdag med don dam stong nyid kyis rtogs par bya ba dang*/ dgongs gzhi ni/ snang ba 'di la bdag dang bdag gis phyogs su bzung ba cha nas kun rdzob/ de nyid bdag gam bdag gir stong zhing phyogs med rang snang ba'i cha nas don dam zhes bya'o// ces gsungs so// de ltar ma ste don dam 'di nyid don dam min la/ 'di'i rang bzhin don dam yin ces pa la sogs 'di dang 'di'i rang bzhin du phye nas yin min du 'dod pa'o// gsang thig las/

gzung 'dzin gnyis med chos nyid la// phra ba tsam ni rtag pa ste// rtag pa'i grub ma tha' thams cad kyis// yang dag rtogs par mi 'gyur ro// ces dang*/ mdo' las/ chos gang sems kyis de nyid las// gnyis dang mtha' rugang lta 38) ba| |ma rig 'khrul pas phyin ci la sogs /brgal lan las/ don dam kun rdzob gnyis phye nas// dam pa'i rnam grangs skye med dang*// gnyis med bsam 'das brjod 'a tha snyad bral laugs/ de kun thams cad blo'i yul yin te byang chub gegs// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ chos thams cad dgos byed dang dgos gzhi gnyis med dang dbyer med log pa yin te/ dgos byed ni gzung 'dzin dang blang dor la sogs pa'i gol ba dgag cing yul sems gnyis su med par bya ba dang*/ dgongs gzhi ni chos kun sems nyid rang snang la gzung 'dzin logs pa yin min gyis sel med pas na dgongs pa 'o// de ltar rtogs te snang stong dang*/ bzang ngan la sogs pa gcig du 'dres nas med par 'dod cing ma 'dres pa'i snang ba 'khrul bar 'dod pa'o// gsang thig las/ bdag gzhan yod med la sogs kyis// 'du shes gang du'ang mi skye ste// mi skye ba yang 'dod pa med// 39) /yod min med min mu rtug chad// ces dang*/ mdo' las/ kun du ma 'dres mi shes bar// bzang po'i tshig la tho gtad nas// kun du bzod par khas len par// mun pa'i skye mched nyid du ltung*// ces dang*/ brgal lan las/ gnyis gcig gnyis med byas na de rang gnyis// gcig ste gnyis dang gnyis med bya byed 'byung*// byas ba'i gnyis med de yang 'khrul pa'i blo// de nas thun mong ma yin gnyis med de// gsang sngags zhes su rdo rje sems dba' gsungs// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa theg pa 'og ma gong ma'i lam rtagasagol pa bstan pa la gnyis te/ gol pa dang*/ lam rtags so// snga ma ni/ theg pa gong ma lam du 'jug nas 'og ma'i lta ba la ma rtogs par/

gong mar rlom pa ni/ gong ma la sgrib cing*/ 'og mar gol ba yin te/ mdo' las/ sa dang rnam thar la sogs pa// chos kun byang chub 40) dkar ba'i lam mchog phyogs// kun kyang bsam du med ba'o// gol sgrib chen bo nyid du 'gyur// ces dang*/ mdo' lam rim las/ mun pa'i shel dang log sred dang*/ byis pa'i shes dang gso rig shes// mtha' dbus 'byed pa'i shes pa rnams// dam pa nyid kyis gol bar 'gyur// ces dang*/ byang sems las/ gong mar sems bskyed 'og ma'i snying rje skyed// 'og ma la nyams 'og ma'i lam du gol// ces so// sa lasogs pa theg pa gong ma la ltos nas 'og ma rnams gol bar bka' rgyud thams cad nas gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ 'og ma 'og ma la sbyor nas rim gyis gong ma la mos shing 'jug pa ni/ lam stegs su 'gro bar gsungs te/ mtshan brjod las/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gis 'bras bu gnas// ces dang*/ gsang snying las/ sa gnas khyad par bkod pa yang*// gsang ba'i snying po 'gro 41) /ba'i lam// ces so// lam rim las/ theg pa bzhi'i nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gis 'bras bu gnas// lam stegs mngon du rdzogs par sbyor// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa bhai pa'i gol pas ni/ lta ba log pa'i rjes su bhai pa dang*/ lta med lo ka'i bhai pa dang*/ theg pa 'og ma'i bhai pa gol sa dang*/ lam stegs su 'gro ba gong gis skabs bzhin shes par bya'o/ dang po ni/ mu stegs dang*/ zhor 'byung la sogs lta ba log pa'i rjes su bhai pa rnams yin te/ gong bzhin du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lta ba bdag med la sogs pa'i don ma rtogs pas bsam gtan mnyam gzhag la gol ba la bzhi ste/ dran pa rgyun 'gogs 'du shes med pa'i bhai pa dang*/ snang ba rgyas 'debs yid sbyod blo'i bhai pa dang*/ bde' gsal nyams zhen bsam gtan bzhi'i bhai pa dang*/ cad med stong bhai skye mched mu bzhi'i

42) bhai pa'o// dang po ni/ nam mkha' klong yangs las/ bde sdug ma dran btang snyoms ni// gzhi gnas ming btags gti mug ste// gang gis blo yang ma zhugs pas// dge sdig gnyis su lung ma bstan// ces dang*/ gsang thig las/ gnyis med ma rtogs dran rtogs med par bhai// 'du shes med pa'i khrod du de skye nges// ces so// gnyis pa ni/ brgal len las/ rang rang snang srid dbyer med pa// rtogs nam blo yul ma zad na// bdag nyid blo yul byas pa yi// nyams len thams cad bdag nyid 'ching*// ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ gong gis don ltar ma rtogs par// blo ngan mnyams pa'i khungs phyung nas// ma rtogs le lo bsnyoms las byed// don ma grub par ngan song 'gro// ces pa dang/ bsam gyis mi khyab ma shes pas// bsam med dkyil 'khor 'jug pa ni// blun rmongs mun 'khrul blo can de// long ba'i grong 43) /khyer chen por 'gro// ces pas/ gong gis lta ba gol ba'i bhai pa rnams so// gsum pa ni/ las dang gol sa bsam gtan gyis skabs su bshad pa bzhin te/ nam mkha' klong yangs las/ rang sems ma rtogs rtsol ba de/ yul gyis 'byung ba sems bsdus nas// gsal stong mnya gzhag don tshol bas// dug lnga bhai pa'i gang zag de/ bying rgod 'phrang dgo bya ra mkhan// lta ba mi shes gti mug ste/ gsal la mi rtogs 'dod chag bhai// bde' la zhen pa'i dargyal can// nyon mongs spang pa'i zhesdang gis// rtsa dang thig le thabs bhai nas// yul la dmigs pa'i thabs bhai pa'o// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ gsang thig las/ nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams mtha' bral bhai| |mtha' bral 'dod pa'i mtha' ste nam mkha' mtha'ayas skye// ces dang*/ 'di bhai nges med gcig dang du ma bral// bhai med blo yul cir 44) yang med par skye// ces pa dang*/ thams cad sems yin cir snang cir med na// rnam shes mtha' yas gnas su de skye nges// ces pa dang*/

bdag gzhan yod med la sogs kyis// 'du shes gang du yang mi skye ste// mi skye ba yang 'dod pa mni// yod min med min mu rtug chad// ces pa la sogs rgyud lung man ngag du ma nas gsungs so// gsum pa spyod pa ni/ lta ba log pa'i rjes su spyod pa dang*/ theg pa 'og ma'i spyod par gol ba'o// dang po ni/ mu stegs kyis spyod pa'i rjes su gol ba dang*/ zhor 'byung gis spyod pa log par gol ba'o// snga ma ni/ gong gis 'dres/ theg pa 'og ma'i spyod par gol ba la spyi dang*/ bye brag las/ dang po nas/ spyi las rgyu 'bras khyad dusad nas dge sdig 'chol bar spyod pa dang*/ chos brgyad kyis kun nas blang ste tshul chos kyi rang bzang por 'dod cing*/ brtson 'grus bor 45) /'dod kyang rang 'ching zhing gzhan la gnod pa dang*// dus tshod dang ma 'brel smyo spyod la sogs pa byed pa'o// gnyis pa bye brag la gnyis te/ mdzad pa chos srol las log pa dang*/ rgyud pa bka' babs las log pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ bka' zung ro zung du 'chad pa dang*/ mdos grags rtogs tshugs su dang*/ 'grel thig gtan pa'i skor du dang*/ snyan rgyud tho chor 'chad pa'o// snga ma ni/ chos nyid kyis rgyud pa med pas phyogs gcig dam par lta zhing*/ rang dang mi mthun pa rnams/ chos med ces bskur ba 'debs pa ste/ de ni chos spang pa'i las kyi ngan 'gror ltung ba'o// rnal 'byor don yod spyod pa'i rgyud las/ theg pa la phyogs ris su bzung nas dmod pa ni/ nyams shing mnar med 'gro gsungs so// ces dang*/ gcan 'phrang las/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung phyogs med la// martogs phyogs dang ris bzung nas// phyogs 46) re rgyu'abras ba sgrub byed kyang*// phyogs med rgyu 'bras ma shes pas// zab mo rgyu 'bras bskur 'debs shing*// rgyal ba'i bka' la smod cing spong*// de'i skal par dka' spyad kyang*// dka' spyad don med 'khor bar 'khyams// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni lung man ngag nyams myong gis cho med par gang zag gis rtogs spyod kyis yin min du 'dzin cing lung gis phyogs la dreg pos bsres pa yin te/

mdo'alas/ bstan pa nam mkha' 'dra ba las// mos pa tha dad par bzung na// yin dang min pa'i cha 'dzin cing*// rtsod pa 'phel bar mi 'gyur ram// zhes zhus pa las/ sems dpa' yod dam med do zhes// byis pa rnams kyis rtsod par byed// mkhas pa ye nas rtsam dang bral// yod med rtogs pa'i tshig mi brjod// ces dang*/ nam mkha' mtha' mnyams las/ chos la phyogs ris bzung ba 47) /yis// rtsod pa'i las su gyur ba dang*// ces dang*/ gcan 'phrang las/ dam pa'i chos la rtsod phyir slob// skyon bcas nyon mongs nga rgyul 'phel// log rtog phyir rgyas rtogs ges bsreg /ces gsungs so// gsum pa ni tshig phyir 'brang nas tha snyad la sogs zhugs kyis tshig mad po shes kyang rtogs pa dang nyams myong gis bcud med pa'o// brgal lan las/ rgyud kyis de nyid mi shes gtams rgyud rlung gis 'khor lo bskor/ lung gis de nyid mi shes lung rgyal 'dam phur 'dra/ ces pa dang*/ mdo' las/ smra brjod tshig la gang dga' ba// gang gis dgongs pa dpag mi nus// tshig tshogs rgya' mtsho thos pa min// tshig gcig don thos thos pa'i ma chog /ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ zab mo'i gdam sa ngag la nyams myong gis dbang po med cing tshig the tshom la dam par bzung nas/ rgyal ba'i 48) bka' rgyud la dmod cing spong ba yin te/ mdo' las/ rmad 'byung gsang ba'i snying po 'di// rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshad ma rnams// phal cher mi gnas skabs dag du// mi shes ngan rtogs can rnams kyis// log lta don slad gzhung bor nas// nor bas sadag gis sun 'byin cing*// 'di'i gzhan rtogs ma yin zhes// bdag stod gzhan la smad pas log /de yang ci lta bu zhes na// skal pa 'di'i dus nyid la| |rnal 'byor dpal sbyin bya ba zhig /don la blo shed ma byed zhing*// bgros kyis thabs la mi mkhas pas// blo gros ngan pa'i gzhung bor nas// chos ma yin pa'i chos brjod cing*// nges pa'i bgros ldan gzhan dag la// de ltar ma nges blo gros ni// bdag gis blo gros 'di mni zhes// mngon pa'i nga gyal cher spyod pa// de ni srid pa log pa'i lam// de 'dra'i tshul 'byung der ma spyod// ces dang*/

rnal 'byor 49) /chos 'byung las/ man ngag lung la spyad rtogs shing*// snyan ngag bsdebs sbyor glu dbyangs slob// de dag spangs pa'i dmyal bar 'tshe// ces dang*/ gcan 'phrang las/ man ngag nges dang drod mod par// nga'i bka' las bzang ba med// de skad zer zhing gzhan bslus nas// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyud pa bka' babs las log pa la bzhi ste/ bcos ma sel dang bcas pa dang*/ byin rlabs kyis na bun yal ba'i dang*/ bar chad bdud kyis khyer ba'i dang*/ rgyud pa lung gzhan du 'byin pa can no// dang po ni/ khung nas khungs su rgyud pa'idrod med par/ yig 'byams la rang bzo' bcos te/ zab mo yin zhes gzhan bslu' bar byed pa'o// rnal 'byor don yod pa spyod pa'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' bcos pa dang*/ slad pa dang*/ phri skur byas na chos ci byas 50) kyang 'bras bu med cing nyams so// de ci'i phyir zhes na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' las thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa lta ci smos/ sa ba cu pa'i byang chubasems dpa' rnams kyis kyang*/ tshig gis sgros bskur ma bcug pa'o// ces pa dang*/ gcan 'phrang las/ mi shes log pa'i bshes gnyen ni// yang dag don dang mi ldan par// bcos mas dam pa'i tshul 'dzin cing*// 'dra tshul log par ston pa ni// dam pa'i mdzod gnyer mi ldan pas// snod mi ldan sems 'dod pa yi// prag dog sgog du bu rnams las// khyad par khyod min bya'o zhes// sgyu ma 'drid nor 'bras bu bslu byed cing*// khung gis dbang lung ma thob bar// ta snad zung du byed pa dang*// khe grags dbang gyur snod med la// bya sgron lta zhing bka' la 'jud// ces pa dang*/ nam mkha' klong yangs las// gsang ba'i man ngag ma go bar// slob bu ma byas slob dpon ring*// 51) /khung nas rgyud pa'i man ngag la// ma nor yin par ma'i rtsi'i bar// rang bzo' kha tshab che ba la// yid ches byed cing dam par 'dzin// lta dman rnams kyis ngo bsrungs byed// /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/

byin rlabs kyis na bun dang*/ nyams myong gis chu rgyun chad/ tshig tsam la brten te bshad pa'o// de nyid las/ chos rnams kun gyis rtsa ba 'di// bla ma dag la ma brten na// gsang sngags gsang ba'i sgor zhugs nas// rang dbang ma thob gzhan dbang bskur// mkhas pa dmod cing mnyam la 'dren// rang la don gyis gdengs med par// grags shing nga rgyal mkhas 'dod na// tshig tsam lung la khung phyung nas// rtsal bshad tho ces gzhung nyams byed// dmyal bar nges 'gro rtag du 'khyams// ces dang*/ gcan 'phrang las/ byin rlabs nyams myong chu rgyun chad// slob dpon 52) ma brten dbang ma gnos// chos 'chad byed pa'i rnam smin ni// lcags kyi dra bar lus bcug nas// ces gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ bdud kyis khyer zhing chos log ston par byed pa ste/ mdo' las/ rmongs pa mun bar gang spyod pa// sngags pa bdud kyis las byed de// shi nas dmyal ba chen por 'gro// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa ni/ bla ma grags pa chung ba la zhus nas/ grags pa che ba la sogs pa la khung 'byin pa yin te/ rnal 'byor don yod pa spyod pa'i rgyud las/ gzhan man ngag can la zhus nas khung gzhan grags che ba dang*/ rang gang dad pa la'adod pa rnams ni/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang rnam par smin pa la bros pa'i thabs med ceng*/ 'bras bu mnar med pa'i sems can bskal pa tshad las 'das pa'i gro bar gsungs nas 'dug pas/ nge nyid du lta bar bya'o// gcan 'phrang las/ gang gis man ngag khung 53) /sub cing*// sgrang phyir khung 'byin che ngag can// bskal pa brgyad khrir sdug bsngal thob// ces gsungs so| |spyi don bzhi pa 'bras bu'i gol sa ni/ 'jig rten da dang*/ log pa'i lta bhai spyod pa rnam kyis ni/ 'khor ba las mi grol zhing*/ ngan song du 'gro bar gsungs te/ gsang thigs las/ nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes shing*// rang rig tshad dang mi ldan zhing*// gzung 'dzin mtshan ma ma grol bas// rang gis gar skyes ma shes pas// 'ol phyir phyogs su gang bhai kyang*// long ba'i goms par zhen te phyal par gol// ces dang*/

mdo' las/ sbas pa'i don rnams smrar gyur nas// spyod khong tsam du byed pa rnams// sku gsum thugs kyis slu byed yin// ces gsungs so// gzhan yang lung dpag tu med pa nas gsungs pas 'di nyid lta bar bya'o// gol sa ltung ba'i sgo dgu' ni/ 54) mdo' bsres las/ bdud dang srin po ru tra dang*// bgegs chen can dang sho bhai nas// ldan te gnod sbyin mu stegs dang*// da myal bar chad pas ltung ba'i sgo// ces pas/ gzhan gyis bsam bzang po lo bar du gcod cing bsam pa log pas bdud du ltung bar gsungs te/ rang byung bde ba 'khor lo las/ gzhan gyis bsam pa bzang po la// bar chad byed pa bdud yin te// ma rtogs ser sna byed pa ni// bdud kyis sgor ltung 'khor bar 'khyams// ces so// khro bo rang rgyud du bhai pas srin po ltung ste/ mdo' las/ bder gshegs rgyal ba bhai bzlas pas// cha mthun bcos pa'i che 'phrul ltar// gang gis der rtags der gyur nas// las kyi srin po'i rig 'dzin yin// ces pas dag/ rang byung bde ba 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ mnyam nyid ma rtogs rang rgyud du// chags sdang pho tshod pa'i lam// dug lnga rang dkar spyad nyes pas*/ 55) /srin po'i sgo ltung rta gdu 'khor// ces so// lta ba log cing chags sdang rang dkar spyod de/ gzhan gyis slob dpon byas ru tra ltung ste/ de nyid las/ ji bzhin ma nor ma rtogs pas// lta log gzhan gyis slob dpon byed// rang nyid mi shes gzhan sgrol ba// ru tra'i sgo ltung rtag du 'khor// ces dag*/ nges dom 'dus pa gter gyis rgyud las/ lta ngan spyod ngan sna tshogs byed/ rang gis ma shes gzhan sgrol ba// ru tra'i sgo ltung dmyal bar skye// ces gsungs so// she khrag la sogs rang dkar dmar spyod cing gnod sems gegs su ltung ba yin te/ mdo' las/ sha khrag la sogs rdzas chen lnga// dngos po kho nar der brtag na// 'byung po khrag gis dri bsnams pa'i// lus len rigs ni 'dzin pa yi// ces dang*/

nges don 'dus pa gter gyis rgyud las/ ma rtogs 'phrin 56) las ci mkhas kyang*// tshogs la mngon par 'dzin pa yi// rang rgyud dam pas mngon zhen phyir// gegs dang bya rog mngon zhen ltung*// ces gsungs so// khro mo la sogs dang rang rgyud du bhai zhing*/ 'khor dang sde brgyad rigs su bcad pa she ma can du ltung ba yin te/ mdo' las/ mtshan ma'i mgo' brnyan bla gtags can// de 'drar gang gis nges brten nas// sho gam gnas kyis gcan chen rigs// ces pa dang*/ nges don 'dus pa'i gter las/ rang dbang ting 'dzin ma thob pas// sde la 'khor dang rigs su bcad// bdag nyid 'khor dang che 'dod pas// gcan chen sho gam dag du ltung*// ces so// zhi ba rang rgyud du bhai pa dang*/ chags pa rang dag ra spyad pas/ lha chen por ltung ba yin te/ mdo' las/ rgyan dang cha lugs thams cadakun/ gang gos de dang deta btag nas// bram ze mi sdug lus 57) /rig 'dzin// ces pa dang*/ rang byung bde ba 'khor lo las/ thabs lam dbang la khung byung ste// 'dod chags rang dgar gtam spyod pas// bde ba ma zin bde la zhen// lha chen sgo ltung 'khor bar 'khyams// ces so// ging dang dbang phyug la sogs rang rgyud du bhai zhing*// 'phrag dog gis gnod sbyin du ltung ba yin te/ mdo' las/ las kyi dbang bcan bran mo'i tshogs// de 'dra nyid du nges bstan nas// gnod sbyin nag po'i tshogs su ltung*// gzhan gyis tshel 'tshe ba yin// ces pa dang*/ bde ba 'khor lo las/ gzhan gyis chos la 'phrag dog pas// yon tan du ma ldan gyur kyang*// rang sems snying po ma rtogs na// gnod sbyin sgor ltung rtag du 'khor// ces so// lta ba log pa'i mu stenags su ltung ba yin te// de nyid las/ ma rtogs pa dang bdag 'dzin pas// gsang sngags lta 58) spyod yin zer na// sems can srog la brtse' med spyod// mu stegs rtag chad sgor ltung 'khyams// ces so// tshig tsam la khung phyung nas dge sdig khyad du bsod cing*/

chags sdang rang dkar spyad pas dmyal bar yin te/ mdo' las// dga' 'khur spyod cing 'dod dgu 'jol// spyod khung tsam du byed pa rnams// dmyal chen dmyal ba brgyad kyis yang*// rdo rjed myal ba chen por ltung*// zhes pa dang*/ nges don 'dus pa'i gter las/ ma rtogs las kyi rtsing spyod pas// lus ngag yid kyis len ba'i phyir// mi dge ba la spyod pa rnams// dmyal bar nges 'gro gtan du 'khyams// ces sogs gsungs/ hām̐ la sogs pa'i yig 'bru rang rgyud du bhai pas/ sdug bsngal sdug pa can du skye ba dang*/ chags pas mngal gyis srin bur skye ba la sogs gsungs so// mdo' las/ de nas gsang ba'i snying po 'di// gol sa che bar rgyal bas gsungs/ 59) /ces gsungs so/ spyi don gnyis pa sgrib pa ni/ las kyis sgrib pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'o// dang po ni/ thog ma med nas nas bsags pa'i las kyis rnam pas smin pa yin te/ tshe 'di la myong gyur gyis las dang*/ phyi ma la myong gyur gyis las dang*/ lan grangs gzhan la myong gyis las so// gnyis pa nyon sgrib ni/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis nyon mongs pa dug lnga la sogs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ shes bya shes su ma ster ba'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes pa'i don la 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa'o// snga ma ni| shes bya'i don de kho na nyid la sgrib pas sgrib pa'i/ lhan ceg skye ba'i sgrib pa dang*/ kun rtags kyis ma rig pa ste/ rang gis rang la sgrib pa dang*/ log pa'i rkyen gyis rtogs su mi ster ba'i sgrib pa dang*/ kun rtags kyis ma rig pa ste/ rang gis rang la sgrib pa dang*/ log pa'i rkyen gyis rtogs su mi ster ba'i sgrib pa rnams gong gis gol sa rnams dang mtshungs so// gnyis pa 60)shes bya'i don la 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa ni/ mthong lam mthong ba'i chos la ched du 'dzin pas kun 'gro'i sgrib pa dang*/ bhai lam la bhai pa cher 'dzin yod pas lhan cig gnas pa'i sgrib pa dang*/

mthar las la shugs las byung ba'i mnyam rjes cha phra mo zhig yod pas/ bag la nyal gyis sgrib pa'o// de rnams rang rang gis skabs su shes par bya'o// spyi don bzhi pa/ rtogs nas nyams su blang ba'i lam bstan pa la bzhi ste/ lam gyis cha rkyen dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ bgrod tshul dang*/ bye brag rgyas par bshad pa'o// lam dang lam gyis khyad par ni/ khog gzhung las/ skabs kyi gtso dang grogs kyis tshul/ skabs kyi gtsor gyur pa la lam zhes bya la/ de'i grogs byed ba'i ngos nas cha rkyen yin no gsungs/ de la cha rkyen ni/ don bsdus las/ de rkyen yan lag rnam gnyis te// bsgrub byed rkyen 61) /dang shes byed rkyen// ces pa dang*/ rin po che rgyan las/ de'i cha rkyen yan lag gsum// rtogs par byed dang goms byed thabs// ngang las gnas pa'i bar chad bsrung*// ces pas/ lam shes byed kyis yan lag dang*/ bsgrub byed kyis dang*/ de'i bar chad bsrung ba'o// dang po ni/ spyir rgyud lung man ngag gsum dang*/ de'i rjes su 'jug pa'i rigs pa la sogs rgyas par gzhung bzhung du shes par bya'o// bye brag du 'og du rang rang gis skabs su ston to// gnyis pa ni/ spar khab las/ lta spyod dkyil 'khor dbang dam rdzas kyi dang*// 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i las rim gyis// gsang sngags rgyud kyis dbye' ba bya// ces pa dang*/ yongs su shes pa'i dngos po bdun la bya'o// don bsdus las/ lam gyis yan lag sayam cu gnyis// mdo' sde gzhi dang slab pa'i gzhi/ 62) /ces pa dang*/ rgyan las/ dbang dang dam tshig dkyil 'khor dang*// 'phrin las rtogs tshad goms byed spyod/ sa dang lam dag 'dir bzhag go /ces klong dgu' nas kyang bshad do// de tshi yang don 'dus bzhin 'dus te/ de la gsang sngags kyis bkol mdo' bcu gnyis dang*/ bsgrub da bzhi bcu dang*/ slab pa'i mtha' bcu'o// dang po ni/ don bsdus las/ mdo' ni bcu gnyis 'jug sgo dang*// dam tshig lta ba ting 'dzin dang*// dmigs pa bzlas brjod 'phrin las dang*// spyod pa dang ni thob bya dbang*// rig 'dzin pa dang sangs rgyas pa// nges 'byed yan lag dang tu bshad// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/

gzhi' ni rnam bcu sgrub pa dang*// gsang sngags mi dang spyod pa dang*// dngos grub gnas dang zlas pa'i smra// phyag rgya ting 'dzin lta ba dang*// cho 'phrul dag de de ga don// dpe 'a bcus mtshon mtshon pas shes rab 63)/gnas// ces gsungs so// ces gsum pa ni/ slab pa'i mtha' ni rnam bcu' ste// dam tshig bzhi dang rgyud 'grol dang*// sgo bsrung ba dang phul dbyung dang*// thag gcad pa dang nyams blangs dang*// la dor spyod dang dbang rim dang*// man ngag don dang mdor bsdus rnams// rnal 'byor slab pa'i mtha' bcur bzhen// ces gsungs/ gang ltar bshad kyang lam thams cad slab pa'i mtha' bcur 'dus te/ de yang dang po gzhi dam tshig gis sa gzhi gshin pa lta bu ni/ kun 'dus las/ spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig las// ces pas/ spyi'i dam tshig ni/ lha mi dge' bcu dang*/ nyan thos kyis 'dul khrims dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la sogs tshul bzhin du bsrungs ba dang*/ don du mi gyur ba thams cad bsrung zhing*/ don 'gyur ci yang nyams su len da bstan pa/ dam tshig klong 64) las/ dam tshig kun gyis thog ma ni// don du mi 'gyur kun spangs nas// don 'gyur ci yang nyams su blang*// ces gsungs so// khyad par ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag la sogs rang skabs su ston par 'gyur ro// lhag pa ni/ dam tshig gis klong las/ lhag pa'i don la rgyun du gnas// ces dang*/ don bsdus las/ gzhi 'dzin pa yi dam tshig ni// sgo gsum sdom par gnas pa'i don// rtsa ba yan lag la sogs pa'i/ bsrung dang bsgrub pa de nyid do// ces sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyud thos bsam gyis dgrol ba gyi lang gyis sgrogs sgrol dogs chod/ mi shes bcing ba kun grol nas/ shes bya kun la thog med 'byung ste/ gcan 'phrang las/ 65) dper na gyi ling sgrogs grol ltar// rnam grol thos bsam bhai mos kyi// shes rgyud kun grol thog med 'gro| |thob bam rgyud dkrol shin tu ces// ces so// gsum pa sgo kun nas bsdur ba bung bas rtsi tshol ba lta bu ni/

mu steg dang zhor 'byung gis mu stegs dang*/ theg thams cad kyis lta spyod log pa kun shes par byas nas/ mthar rang gis brub mtha' ma nor ba nyid rtogs par byed pa yin te/ de nyid las/ dper na bung ba rtsi tshol ltar// lta spyod sgo bstun bsdur byas nas// ma nor don nyid rtogs bya'i phy-ir/ sgo rnams bsdur ba rab tu gces/ ces gsungs so// bzhi pa phul du mkhas pas byung ba mtho' ri rtser phyin pa lta bu ni/ shes rab kyi chos gang la'ang ma rmongs par shes shing*/ khyad par du sems kyis de kho na nyid la mkhas shing phul du byung bya ba yin te/ de nyid 66) las/ dper na mtho' ri rtser phyin pa ltar// shes rab mtho' ri rtser phyin te// kun la mkhas shing phul du 'byung*// don la mkhas pa rab du gces// ces so// lnga pa rim pa dbang gis bgrod pa rgyal bu dmangs su 'khyams pa rgyal bar ston pa ni/ lam dang rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba/ dbang la byung ba yin pas/ phyi nang gsung gyis dbang la sogs pa skur bas/ ma smin pa smin par byas/ ma grol ba grol ba byas te/ rgyud gong nas gong du 'phar nas/ chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang thob pa yin te/ de nyid las/ rgyal bu rgyal sar ston pa ltar// rim pa dbang gis khyad par te// sa la ma rtsal gyis bgrod pa yi// dbang rnams thob pa rab du gces// ces so// drug pa thag lta bas gcad pa khyung nam mkha' la lding ba lta bu ni/ chos kun mnyam rang snang du rtogs pas phyogs ris re dogs med bar thag 67)chod pas/ gang la'ang nyam nga med par byas te/ de nyid las/ khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzh-in// theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam yas kyang*// mnyam nyid re dogs blang dor med// the tshom med pa shin tu bces// ces so// bdun pa don man ngag gis bsdud gser 'gyur gyis rtsi lta bu ni/ snyan rgyud zhal gyis man ngag gis mngon du ngo sprod pas/ tshegs med cing bde blag du gyur pa yin te|

de nyid las/ sgyur ba sman snang gser 'gyur ltar// sems kyis gsang 'di sus mthong pa'i// man ngag can gyis 'grub pa'i phyir*// man ngag ldan pa rab tu gces// ces gsungs so// rgyas pa ni/ nyams su ting nge 'dzin gyid blangs ba rgya mtshor nor ldan gyis mi lta bu ni/ shes kyang nyams su ma blangs na don mi grub cing*/ rtogs pa'i don dka' bas nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa mthar phyin te bdag gzhan 68) gyis dom rnams 'grub pa yin te/ de nyid las*/ dper na rgya mtsho'i nor lan mi// nyams su ma blang nor med cing*// dka' bas nyams su don rnams 'grub// ting 'dzin sgom pa rab tu bces// ces gsungs so// dgu pa ni/ la spyod pas dor ba glang chen chur zhugs pa lta bu ni/ rang rang gis skabs nas bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya ste/ 'bras bu thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa'i spyod pa dus dang 'brel par dka' bla gang lam nyam nga med par 'jug pa yin te/ de nyid las/ dper na glang chen chur 'jug ltar// rtsal sbyangs pa yi bgrod tshul gyis// nyam nga bag tsha med pa ru// spyod pa dus dang 'brel da ces/ bcu pa ni/ mdo' gcig tu 'dus pa 'gron po byes logs nas slar rang khyim du 'ong ba lta bu ni/ theg pa rnam grangs cig gsungs pa dang*/ lam ci ltar bgrod kyang 69) sems nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su gsungs la/ don sems nyid rtogs pa la thams cad 'dus shing rdzogs da yin te/ de nyid las/ dper na kun tu rgyuba'i mi/ 'dod pa'i yul du gang 'gro ba// yul gyis rnam pa mtha' yang kyang*// bgrod yul lam gnas gcig la med// de bzhim bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// rnam grangs chos sgo ci snyed kyang*/ bkri' bas grang ba'i tshig yin te// bsam pa'i yul 'di gcig pa'o// don rnams gcig tu bsdus nas ni// slab par bya ba dang dam pa ste// nges par gcig las med pa'i phyir// kun 'dus dam pa slabo gces// ces gsungs so// gsum pa de'i ngang la gnas pa'i lam chad bsrung ba ni/

bla ma dkon mchog la bla bkal nas gsol ba btab dang*/ snying rje dang byams pas bgegs rigs la gtor byin te/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa dang*/ 70) mkha' 'gro chos skyod la gtor tshogs btang ste las bcol ba dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bhai zhing*/ yi dam lha'i bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ rtogs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa gang la yang nyam nga med par grogs su 'khyer ba'o// de rnams rgyas par rang gis gzhung dang bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya'o// gnyis pa lam gyi ngo bo ni/ rim gsum las/ ngo bo shes rab rnams su nyid// ces dang*/ don bsdus las/ ngo bo thabs dang shes rab ste// ces pas/ go bo thabs dang shes rab la bya/ dpe' chung gnas las/ 'jig ldanal sogs byang sems lnga// nges par skye ba ngo bo yin// ces pas/ ngo bo sems lnga las bshad/ rdzogs chen las/ rtogs nas 'dris pa gang byed pa/ lam gyis ngo bo byang chub sems// ces so// lam gyus ngo bo byang chub sems kas bshad do// de rnams gang la yang mi 'gal bar sems kyis 'phel rim du 71) /'dus pas/ngo bo sems lnga 'am/ sems kyis 'phel rim la bya'o// mdo' sde las/ de la thog mar stan pa'am// skye ba rkyen gyis skye tshul dang*// skye ba'i ngo bo sems dpa' dang*// tha mar rang byung nyid kyis rdzogs// ces pas/ de la gsum ste| skye ba bzhi'i skye ba bsten pa dang*/ rgyu rkyen dang*/ skyes tshul lam/ rim pa ston pa'o// dang po ni/ gzhi nas sems skye ba dang*/ lam nas skye ba dang*/ 'bras bu mas skye ba dang*/ skye ba la nges pa nas skye ba'o// mdo' sde las/ theg pa mchog phyir skye ba'am// mun pa long sres byis pa'i sa// phyogs ris mtha' la dam pa phyes// drug pa rgyu rkyen dbang gis g.yo'// de las byung tshul rnam pa gsum// thog ma nyis nas rgyud pa dang*// gzhi gnas ma nges gang byung bgrod// mtha' nas thog rtsir gcig char 'jug /ces gsung sa/

gnyis pa rgyud gnyis 72) dang*| rkyen bzhi ste/ bgrang*/ de la mtshungs ldan gyis rgyu/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po rang chas su gnas pa dang*// lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu gong ma'i yon tan thob pas/ 'apag ma la skyo/ gong ma la brod cing dad skye ba'o// rkyen bzhi ni/ rgyu'i rkyen snying po'i don gyis gnas pa dang*/ rang rang gis sa la skye ba skyes pa dang/ bdag po rkyen bla ma dam pa/ dmigs pa'i rkyen gsang sngags kyis yaun tan la sogs pa| mtshungs pa de ma thag pa'i rkyen ni snga ma snga mas go phyes nas*// phyi ma phyi mar 'brel pa'o/ lam rim las/ snying po rang bzhin mtshungs pa dang*// bshes gnyen mgon la chung yang thos// yod tan mthong dang skyen mthong dang*// de'i skyo rmong brod dngas pas// gnyis pa'i rgyu rgyu gsungs pa yin// de bas gsang sor dmigs pa ste// skad cig 'phel ba de ma theg /ces gsungs so// de las 73) 'brel pa ni/ dpon slob gnyis las dang thugs rje'i 'brel pa yod/ slob bu dang bstan pa'i chos gnyis snod bcud dam shes bya shes byed kyis 'brel pa yod/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum pa bdag nyid gcig pa'am/ ngo bo nyid kyis 'brel pa yod pa'o// gsum pa skye tshul ni/ de ltar rgyu rkyen 'tshogs pas gong bzhin sems lnga'i tshul du skye ba yin te/ bgrang*/ de la g.yo' ba byang chub kyis sems ni/ gsang snga gas don spros shing mos pa g.yo' ba'o// smon pa'o// rtogs shing khongs du chud na ci ma rung mnyam pa'i 'dun pa dang smon pa byed pa'o// 'jug pa byang chub sems ni/ dngos su gsang sngags don gyis sgor zhugs pa ste| dbang 'gyur nas nyan bsam la sogs byed pa'o// gnas pa byang chub sems ni/ rtogs shig dgos par byed pa ste/ lam nyams 74) su len pa'o// mthar phyin pa'i byang chub kyis sems ni/ stobs su gyur lam mthar phyin pas skyed byar med pa'o// de yang snga ma snga mas go phye nas/

phyi ma'i phyi ma'i don gsal bar byed pa'o// lam rim las/ snga ma snga ma gang dang gang*// phyi ma phyi ma thabs dang rgyu// de bzhin phyi ma phyi ma gang*// snga ma snga ma ma byung 'bras/ ces gsungs so// 'o na sems lnga lam gyis ngo bo yin na/ sems lnga mthar phyin pas lam lnga mthar phyin nam ma phyin/ mthar ma phyin na sems lam gyis ngo bo yin pas nyams la/ phyin na tshogs lam lta bu'i sems lnga mthar phyin pas kyang lam lnga mthar phyin par thal/ ces na/ lam spyi'i sems lnga mthar phyin la/ bye brag lam lnga mthar ma phyin no// yang sems lnga lam gyi ngo bo yin na/ gcig char ba sems lnga las skye'am mi skye/ ma skye na lam gyis ngo bo yin 75) pa nyams la/ skye na gcig char ba ma yin par 'gyur ro// zhes na/ gcig char ba la sems skye yang don 'khor 'das dbyer med la dus myur bar skye ste/ se gol gcig la 'am sems lnga skye bas gnyis ka'i skyon mi yong ngo// gsum pa lam bgrod tshul ni/ dbang po rno brtul gyis rim skye ba dang*/ gcig char ba'i rigs rnams/ theg pa'i rang rang gis skabs su 'og nas ston par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa bye brag so so nas rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis te/ thabs lam dang*/ grol lam mo// de la thabs lam ni/ yod pa shes rab yod kyang thabs dang gdams ngag gtso che ma la bya'o// grol lam ni/ yod pa thabs dang gdams ngag yod kyang*/ shes rab gsum gtso' ba'o// de gnyis mgo' shes rab/ khams ltag shal gyis gtag pa ni/ de yang lta ba ni mi thad de/ spyir thams dang shes rab 76) zung du 'brel pa dgos par bshad pa dang*/ bye brag du thabs rkyang pas mi grol zhing*/ thabs la shes rab kyis grol dgos pa gsungs so// yang bye brag du lta ba la sogs shes rab gcig pos grol la/ thabs ched du mi dgos par gsungs te/ nges don 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ theg brgyad lam gyis gol sa ni// khyed cag blo dman ma rig pas// thabs dang ses rab 'brel dgos zer// 'khrul da 'thags pa'i rtogs pa yin/

ces pa la sogs gsungs so// thabs lam ni/ steng sgo rlung 'khor gyis bde ba la brten nas ye shes skye ba 'bul ba ni/ rim skye pa'o// 'og sgo phyag rgya'o bde ba la brten nas ye shes skye ba myur bas na/ gcig char pa'o// de ltar thabs lam la brten nas rig pa 'byongs pa dang*/ shes rab kyis ye shes rang snang ngo sprod pas/ thabs shes zung du 'brel te/ zag bcas kyi bde ba 77) zag med du gyur te/ ye shes rang gnas mngon sum du rtogs nas grol ba yin te/ rim gsum las/ bla ma'i dgongs pa rlung gis dus// sbyor ba'i thabs dang bson nams las// phyag rgya yon tan ldan gyur pas// dngos po lhan cig skyes pa myong*// de phyir thabs su bshad pa yin// ces pa dang*/ don bsdus las/ rol pa'i ka ra la sogs pa'i// man ngag thabs kyi der 'jug dang*// zhes gsungs so// rgyas par gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rang rang gis skabs bzhin shes par bya'o// ༈ gnyis pa grol lam la gsum ste/ mahā yo ga dang*/ a nu yo ga dang*/ a ti yo ga'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gzhi dang*/ lam dang*/ 'bras bu'o// gzhan nas tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni gong nas brjod pa ltar ro// 'dir mdor bsdus te bstan na/ bden pa gsum du 78) bstan pa yin te/ de yang*/ don dam dang*/ kun rdzob dang*/ dbyer med do// dang po ni/ chos thams cad rig pa byang chub kyis spros bral skye ba med cing snang la ngo bo nyid kyis rgyur gnas pa'o// rgyu 'bras rgyas pa las/ phyogs bcu' ma lus thams cad la// rang byung chen po ku tu khyab// rang byung de nyid de nyid dngos med pas// kun gyis phyag rgya rgyu yin no// ces pa dang*/ spar khab las/ gzhi 'gyur gzhi la g.yo' med ltar// snang ba ngo bo nyid kyis rgyu// ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ don mchog lnga 'bras dbyings ye shes// bdun ni gsum phyir don dam las// dpag bsam shing dang rin chen ltar// de kun ngo bo nyid rgyur gnas// ces gsungs so// de nyed chos kun cir snang yang*/

rang rig pa'i cho 'phrul mi dha zhing ye nas chos sku chen por gnas pa yin te/ la shad las/ rang rig ni 79) ma'i ye shes nyid// dngos gnyis la sogs byed pa'i phyir// cho 'phrul nyid las mi zhen pas// dbang bsgyur thabs kyi rgya ma mtshor 'dod// ces dang*/ lam rim las/ 'jig rten brten g.yo' la sogs pa// snang ba nyis nas ngo bo med// de nyid chos sku chen po yin// rang bzhin ngang gis de lta gnas// ces gsungs so// kun rdzob ni/ kun rdzob rang rig pa'i cho 'phrul nyid/ rig pa sgyu ma'i cir snang zhing*/ de nyid phung po khams dang skye mched rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du gnas pa'o// rgyas pa las/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la// rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ye nas gnas// ces pa dang*/ rgyu 'phrul le lag las/ rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags// ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ phung pi khams dang skye 80) mched rnams// gzhi rdzogs phyag rgya ma 'dres bsal// ces pa dang*/ la shan las/ cho 'phrul yul sems tshul nyid kyang*// tabs dang shes rab mtshan nyid de// phung sogs yab yum dkyil 'khor du// rgyud min rang bzhin snang ba nyid// ces gsungs so// dbyer med ni| sems kyi spros bral skye ba nyid kun rdzob rig pa sgyu ma'i ngo bor cir snang la/ cir yang snang ba nyid don dam spros bral skye ba med pa'o// de nyid tshig snga phyi ltar snang yang don la tha dang med de/ rang byung gis ye shes rang snang rang grol du bstan pa'o// rgyas pa las/ gzhi rtsa las ni thams cad byung*// med pa yod pa gnyis ka mi na// don dam kun rdzob dbyer med de// 'dus ma byas nyid 'dus byas snang*// ces da dang*/ lam ram las/ yul dang shes par snang ba yang*// rang byung ye shes rang snang zad// rgyu 'bras snang yang gnyis pa med/ 81) /phyi nang snang ba'am nang nyid dang*// ces pa dang*/ la shan las/

gnyis med byang sems ngo bo la// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid ngang gis med// ces gsungs so// dbang po rab kyis tha ma mahā yo ga'i theg pa la'ang dbayan du nges te/ spyi chings las/ tha ma skyed pa'i rnal 'byor yang*// bdun du nges par snang ba ste// ces pas/ de la bdun te/ 'jug pa'i sgo dang*/ lta ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzim dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dam tshig dang*/ lam gyis yun dang*/ 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ spyi chings las/ dbang po mchog gis tha ma ni// lta spyod bhai pa'i ched 'dzin cing*// thabs dang shes rab sgor zhugs nas// smin grol thabs kyi bye brag kun// kun kyang thabs dang shes rab 'jug /rnal 'byor chen po 'jug pa'i sgo// ces pas/ mahā'i 'jug sgo thabs shes smin grol la sogs 82) gnyis te/ mnyam pa rig med kyis tshul du 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa lta ba la gnyis te/ rtogs thabs dang*/ gtan la dbab pa'i grub mtha' lta bas bstan pa'o// snga ma ni/ lung man ngag dang*/ gsang sngags mngon sum gyis tshad mas mngon sum du ngo sprad cing rtogs par bya ba dang*/ he dus gtan la phab cing rtogs par bya'o// dang po ni/ stong thun gyis skabs nas bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o// gnyis pa he dus gtan la phab pa la gnyis te/ sngon byung sku lnga dang tshul mthun pa'i he du dang*/ tshig gis he du'o// snga ma ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sku'o gsung*/ ngo bo nyid kyis he dus go ba dang*// chos sku'i gsung gis tshul skye med don gyis go ba dang*/ longs sku'i gsung gis dgongs pa brda'i go ba dang*/ rdo rje'i gsung gis tshul grags stong dbyer med dang ba dang*/ sprul sku'i gsung gis tshul tshangs pa'i dbyangs 83) /kyi go ba'o// lam rim las/ rtogs dang ldan pa'i blo rnams la// dngos po sna tshogs sems gsang sngags// nges lung yin phyir chos zhur ston// ces pa dang*/ de nyid las/ chos kyi sku'i gsum lta bus// skye med don gyis gtan la dbab// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gsung lta bus// dgongs pa brda'i gtan la dbab/

sprul pa'i sku'i gsung lta bus// tshangs pa dbyangs kyi gtan la dbab// rdo rje sku'i gsung lta bus*// grags stong dbyer med gtan la dbab// la la ngo bo nyid kyi gsung ltar// snang srid mthong thos gtan la dbab// ces pa la sogs gsungs pas rgyas par der shes par bya'o// gnyis pa tshig gis he du la gnyis te/ dpyad du med pa'i gtan tshigs dang*/ dpyad du yod pa'i gtan tshigs so// snga ma ni/ rtogs spyod rtsis pa med par man ngag bstan pa tsan gyis rang 84) snang yul med du go ba yin te/ lam rim las/ rtags spyod dmigs 'dzin mi tshor bar// de brjod nyid kyis de nyid mthong*// ces so// daphyad pas go ba 'di la gnyis te/ tshig don mi mthun pa'i he du dang*/ mthun pa'i he du'o// snga ma ni/ don thun mong ma yin pa'i cir yang min pa'i phyir/ he du ci yang min par gtan la phebs pa la sogs pa'o// des mtshon ci yang min pa'i phyir// bsan chos ci yang ma yin no// de phyir ma yin kun yin pas// ci yang yin no lhun gyis grub// ces sogs gsungs// gnyis pa tshig don mthun pa ni/ shes rab spyan 'byed las/ tshad ma bka' gzhung gtan tshigs dang*/ sgra mthun don dpag he du'o// ces pas/ snga ma ni/ gsang sngags rang gzhung gis he dus mngon du rtogs par byed pa yin la/ phyi ma ni/ go ba dang sgra mthun yang don khyad par 'phags 85) /te mgon sum du rtogs par byed pa'o// rgyas par gzhung bzhin du shes par bya'o// gzhan yang*/ spyan 'byed las/ ldems dgongs man ngag gtan tshigs gis// skabs kyis de nyid mthong bar byed// dngos po lo rgyus gtan tshigs gis// bdag nyid chen po smos ci dgos// ces pas/ ldems dgongs man ngag he du'i skabs su ngo sprod cing rtogs par bya ba dang*/ dngos po lo rgyus gtan tshigs yid ches par ba zhing dngos su sprod par bya'o// | gnyis ba gtan la phebs pa'i grub mtha' lta ba bstam pa ni/

gong gis bden pa gsum gyis don de nyid khong du chud cing*/ da ltar gyis snang ba 'di nyid rig pa rag snang bas/ lta bya lta byed med bas yul med rang gsal du rtogs pas gol sgrib kyis dmigs 'byed/ don ma nor ba nyis khong du tshud cing the tshom yid gnyis med par gdengs dang ldan pa'o// sbyan 'byed 86) las/ yul med rang gsal nyams rnyed la// thun mong zhes tha snyad rtags par zad// ces pa dang*// lam rim las/ gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid// dmigs med tshul du der snang ngo// ces pa dang*/ don sems can rtogs med gsal// rang byung ye shes thams cad mkhyen// ces pa dang*/ rang rig mngon du dmigs bral bas// rang gsal gsum bral mi 'gul ba// nges par gdeng du gang byas pa// thos bsam byas pa lta mthar phyin// ces gsungs so// lta bya lta byed med pata chos kun rig pa rang gsal du rtogs pa ni/ lta ba'i nges tshig 'grub ste/ spyan 'byed las/ de phyir lta dang med par// chos kun rang rig rang snang bas// me long lta bu'i tshul bzhin du// mi rtogs gsal bas nges tshig 'grub// ces gsungs so// de ltar na cos kun sems nyid rang snang du rtogs pas/ chos spyi dang gis mtshan nyid khong du chud de/ 87)/gdod nas sangs ma rgyas kyis bar du dmigs phyed cing don khong du chud pa'o// lam rim las/ lta ba lta ba gtsor brjod mdo// don du shes bya kun mnyam nyid// ded dpon rin chen ci bzhin du// gdod mtha'i bye brag 'dir shes dgos// ces gsungs so// de ltar zag bcas kyi skabs su chos nyid rang gis mtshan nyid mthong*/ ma mthong ces na go ba dang*/ bye brag phyed pa dang*// mthong la mthong rtogs pa'o// snga ma ni/ chos nyid spyi'i mtshan nyid stong zhing bdag med pa dang*/ rang gis mtshan nyid yul med/ rang gsal du mthong ba'o// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ spyi dang rang gis mtshan nyid dang*/

khyad par spyi dang rang gis mtshan nyid dang*/ don byed nus pa rang gis dang*/ don byed mi nus da spyi'i dang*/ gsal ba rang gis dang*/ mi gsal ba spyi'i dang*/ rgyun 'gag pa rang gis dang*/ mi 'gag pa spyi'i mtshan nyid do// gsum pa ni/ 88) ma mthong 'dod pa dang*/ mthong bar 'dod pa'o// sda ma ni/ zag bcas kyis skabs su chos nyid mthong na/ lung rig pa man ngag gsum dang 'gal ba'i skyon 'ong ste/ lung gis mdo' las/ gzhi gsam pa gsang sngags kyis ngo bo nyid la 'jug go// ces pa dang*/ don bsdus las/ de dag zag bcas pa bsam gtan te// gnyis med yul gabaral de mthong min// ces la sogs so// rig pa ni/ zag bcas kyis skabs su rang gis mtshan nyid mthong na/ zag med dang khyad par med par 'gyur ro// ces la gsungs pa'o// /gnyis pa mthong bar 'dod pa'i lugs ni/ gzhan gyis skyin bsal ba dang*/ mthong ba'i lugs bzhag pa'o*// snga ma ni/ lung man ngag 'gal ba'i skyon mi 'ong ste/ zag med bzhin du ma mthong ba ka dgongs pa'o// rig pa'i skyon yang mi 'ong ste/ rgyu du mas bu la 'phel 'grib can du yod 89) /pas/ zag med dang khyad par yod de/ rgyal ba'isras dang shing sna'i me// rag mtshan mthong yang stobs ma rdzogs// ces so// ༈/gnyis pa mthong ba'i lugs ni/ mthong ba la gsum las/ mthong ba po zag bcas kyis skabs su rgyun dums bu la 'phel 'grib can du mthong ba'o// lam rim dang*/ spyan 'byed la sogs pa lta ba'i skabs nas mthong bar bshad pa dang*/ nyams sgron las/ sprin bar nyi 'dra gsal yid ches// ces pa la sogs pa'o// mthong ba gnyis pa zag med mthong lam gyis skabs su 'grib pa 'phel ba yod pa'o// lam rim las/ skabs 'dir bden pa bar ma mthong*// ces pa dang*/ zag kun zad pa'i rig can de// ci ltar bshad kyang log pa med// ces gsungs so// tha ma ni/ sangs rgyas kyis dud gsum 90) sgrib g.yo' kun dang bral te/

gsal ba mthar phyin la mthong bas/ 'phel 'grib med par mngon sum gyur ba'o// lam rim las/ tha ma'i tha ma zhes bral ba'i// ye shes 'gro 'ong med kun khyab// ces pa dang*// gcan 'phrang las/ rang byung ye shes mngon byas pa'i// spang thob gnyis med de bzhin gshegs// zhen bral kun grol bde chen gyis// dgongs pa gsal 'grob 'gro 'ong med// ces gsungs so| |dang po zag bcas kyi skabs su chos nyid rang gis mtshan nyid mthong ba ni/ lung man ngag rig pa gsum las/ lung ni mdo' las/ rang bzhin ye nas sangs rgyas la// mthong dang ma mthong rnam gnyis las// dman pa'i skabs na de mthong min// mthong ba dam pa'i skabs na'o// mthong ba mngon mthong rnam gnyis las// mthar phyin dam pa mngon sum pa// thos pas mthong bar 'gyur phyir gro// ces 91) pa dang*/ nges don 'dus pa'i rgyus las/ da lta chos skur ma shes na// gsang sngags kyi man ngag ci la tshe// de phyir bstan shes bhai mi dgos// ces pa dang*/ spyan 'byed las/ rgyu 'bras phyir na gcig shos la// yul med rang gsal mngon sum pa'o// ces pa dang*/ lam rim le'i gnyis pa las/ sngags dang dmigs dbya'i med phyir de// de bas yul med rag gsal ba'o// ces gsungs so/ gzhan nam khog dbub kyis skabs kyi chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i lung rnams so/ man ngag ni/ spyi chings las/ snod bcud 'jig rten chos 'di rnams// ye nas rgyal ba'i dkayil 'khor te// ces pa la sogs gsungs so// rig pa ni/ gsang sngags kyis lugs kyis zag bcas kyis skabs su chos nyid rang gis mtshan nyid ma mthong na/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa ma yin/ rgyu lam du byed pa dang khyad par 92) med par thal ba dang*/ chos nyid mngon sum du ngo sprod pa'i man ngan dang*/ rang rig pa'i tshad na rgyun chad thal ba dang*/ mngon sum rtogs par byed pa'i he du rgyun chad pa'i skyon yong ngo// mthong ba'i tshol ni/

gsal ba mthar phyin ma phyin gyis bye brag ste/ dpar na dbang po'i yul du mthong yang thag nye ring gis gsal ba mtha' phyin ma phyin pa bzhin no// lam rim las/ dbang po dngas pa'i spyod yul las// nye ring drug bzhin stobs 'phebs pas// rgyu rkyen gong 'og 'bras bur 'brel*// gsal ba'i bye brag rim par 'gro// ces so// rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid bhai pa ni| |lam rim las/ de yang rang bzhin sbyang pa'i sa// snod du gyur pa nye rim phyir// rim dang gcig char bzhi cha yi// ces pas/ gcig char rim skyes pa'i bye brag bzhi ste/ gcig char ba'i gcig ba'i char ba ni/ rtogs grol dus mnyam pa gong gis sku lnga dang tshul mthun par 93) /rtogs shing grol ba'o// gcig char ba'i/ rin gyis pa ni/ rtogs pa'i don la myong ba'i rgyun brten tsam las lam gyis rim pa med par grol ba'o// lam rim las/ srid pa rdzogs par smin tshul du// lhag pa'i gdengs ldam skyes pa'i bu yi// bhai pa rim bzhi zung ldan pa// gdod ma nyid nas goms par byed// ces so// rim skyes pa la gnyis te/ rim skyes pa'i gcig char ba ste/ thod rgal ba dang rim skyes pa'i rim gyis pa'o// snga ma ni/ zag bcas zag med kyis thod rgal ba yin te/ gong gis le'u lnga pa las/ rnam smin rig pa the tshom med// ces pa dang*/ drug pa las/ snyoms las med par brtson byas nas// lam du rig 'dzin thob pa'am*// ces pa dang*/ brgyad pa las/ rgya dor gcig char mthar 'gro ba// ces pa dang*/ thugs tig las/ lnga pa rnal 'byor bha zhig gis/ 'das tshul gnyis thob 'gyur ba'ang yod// ces gsungs pas/ lam nges med bar du long du 'grod pa yin te/ rgyas par lam rim bzhin du shes par bya'o*// gnyis pa rim pa la gnyis te/ zag bcas dang*/ zag med do// dang po la gnyis te| tshogs gnyis sngon du rdzogs par tshogs lam dang*/ lta ba ting nge 'dzin gyis zag med mthong lam la sbyor lam mo// tshogs lam la bzhi ste/

de bzhin nyid dang*/ kun tu snang dang*/ phyag rgya gcig pa dang*/ phayag rgya spros pa'o// dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyis chos thams cad sems nyid rang snang la dngos po dang mtshan ma med par/ bhai bya bhai byed med par ma bcos de bzhin nyid du bhai zhing zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel du bhai pa yin te/ dngos rnams nyid nang nas dngos med par// rtogs pa'i smra bsam yul las 'das// de 95) bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te// de nyid rang la mi g.yo' ba// gzhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel// ces gsungs pas/ gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rang rig nyid// dmigs med tshul du der snang ngo// dbyings dang dbyings kyis ye shes kyang*// rang rig khi na tsam du zad// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad la// dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje bhai zhing*/ thams cad ye shes sgyu ma'i ngo bor gsal ba yin te/ lam rim las/ snying rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pas// srid gsum sgyu ma lta bu ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhas pas shes 'gro ba'i din du go 'gos te// 'gro ba de ltar snga nas shes// ces pa dang*/ gsang snying las/ log par rtogs rnam dag cing*// ye shes nyid las mi zhen phyir// thugs rje chen por 'brel pas na// 'gro ba dus nas ma lus snang*// ces pa dang*/ lam rim las/ gsod chen snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ 96) mi 'byed phan rdzogs bya mas chen po// mi 'gyid dga' mchog bral med bsnyoms*// changs pa'o rgyud bzhi dus cig rdzogs// ces so/ gsum pa phyag rgya gcig pa ni/ lha yab yum zung cig lhag pa'i lhag dgu dang bcu bhai zhing*/ de nyid snang stong zung 'jug rang bying rang snang du bhai zhing rtsal sbyang pa'o// de yang phyi ma tshang ba srin po'i tshul// rdzogs par bya ba zung du 'gyur// ces pa dang*/

gzhal yas lha'i dkyil 'khorar yang*// sems kyis cho 'phrul rang snang phyir// lha la dmigs med rig pa nyid// gzhi rdzogs sku de rang snang ba'o// ces gsungs so// bzhi pa snang 'byed ni/ dkyil 'khor dang chos 'phril la sogs pa rnams spros pa bhai zhing*/ snang stong zung 'jug ma 'dres yongs rdzogs rig pa rang gsal du bhai pa yin te/ phung sogs dkyil 'khor lhar snang ba| |rgya mtsho'i gzugs brnyan ci bzhin du// kun dngas rang rig lhar gsal bas// gcig dang du ma yongs kyi med// ces dang*/ stong 'phyal nyis 97) kyi phyag rgya dang*// sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor yang*// ri rab til 'bras bu'i tshul bzhin du// dpe' byad mtshan gyis rgyan spras pa'o// gnyis pa sbyor lam ni// bar chad med pa tshogs bsgrab pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas bzhi bzung*/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhis gzhung srang*/ grogs yo byad lnga la brten nas bsgrusu pa yin te/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga yin te// bsnyen sgrub bzhi'i gzhung srang zhing*// yo byad lnga ni rdzogs ldan// ces pa dang*/ gsang snying las/ cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing*// yo byed lnga ni rdzogs par ldan// sngags kyis yan lag rdzogs pa'o// ces gsungs so// dang po phun sum mtshogs pa lnga ni/ ston pa/ gnas/ dus/ 'khar/ sgub thabasaphun sum tshogs pa'o// bsnyen bsgrub bzhi ni/ bsnyen pa nye ba'i bsnyen pa/ bsgrub pa 98) dang bsgrub pa chen po'o// chog lnga ni/ de bzhin nyid/ kun tu snang*/ phyag rgya gcig pa la phra ba yin 'bru la slab pa dang*// yongs su rdzogs pa lha sku la rdzogs pa dang*/ phyag rgya spros pa dang lnga'o// gsang sngags kyis yan lag lnga ni/ thugs rje ye shes sems dpa' dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyis lha gsum/ dbu'i rgyan gyis lha lnga'o/ yo byad lnga ni/ brgyan dang nago' ba'i yo byad/ bza' btung ba'i yo byad/ glu tshig sgra'i/ bro gar 'du 'phro'i/

a li ka li yo byad dang lnga'o// de ltar gong du lta ba'i skabs su bden gsum dbyer med durtogs shing*/ de nyid nyams su len pa la/ tshogs lam de bzhin nyid bhai pa dang*/ kun tu snang stong nyid snying rje dbyer med bhai pas/ snang stong dbyer med phyag rgya gcig pa/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug phyag rgya spros pa chen po mngon sum du brtan pa mthar phyin cing*/ zag 99) bcas kyi lam de nyid zag med la sbyor bar bye pa'i sbyer lam bar chad med par tshogs sgrub pa de yang*/ spyi chings las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i ting 'dzin ni// 'bar desadakyil 'khor thams cad kun// bskyed pa rnam bzhi rin gyis bskyed// cho 'phrul rnam bzhi phyag rgya bzhi// dus bzhi rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// rig pa rang snang dkyil 'khor gnyis// chu dang chu bzhin dbyer med de// ma skyes chos nyid shes rab las// ma 'gag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor snang*// thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'o// ces pas cho 'phrul bzhi dang*/ phyag brgya bzhi dang*/ skyed pa bzhi'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ gong du rnal 'byor yo ga'i skabs dang mthun no// gnyis pa zag med ni/ 'bras bu'i skabs nas bstan bar 'gyur ro// spyod pa ni/ spyir bdag dang*/ gzhan don gyis spyod pa dang*/ zag bcas 100) dang zag med kyis spyod pa// sbyor grol la sogs khyad par can gyis spyod pu yin te/ spyi chings las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i spyod pa ni| |bsnyen bsgrub bzhi dang 'phrin las bzhi// sbyor grol la sogs spyod pa'i chos// bdag gzhan thams cad sgrol bar 'gyur// thabs kyi zan te nyams su blang*// des ni bdag gzhan grol bar 'gyur ro// ces gsungs so// dam tshig la/ brgyad de/ dgos byed/ ngo bo dang*/ nges tshig rnam grangs/ skabs su gang du dgos pa dang*/ bskang ba'i thabs dang*/ nyams pa'i skyon dang*/ bsrung ba'i yon tan bstan pa'o/
